run_graph_optimization_passes: run graph optimization passes on an fx.GraphModule or IterGraphModule using the graph_optimization_pass decorator
fuse_communication_with_concat: fuse allreduce communication operations by concatenating bucketed gradients to reduce communication overhead
schedule_comm_wait_delay: delay the execution of wait tensors of allreduce until the first user to improve execution scheduling
split_fused_optimizer: split a fused optimizer block into two optimizer blocks based on a set of gradients to distribute work
move_grads_and_optimizers: extract a communication block and split out a new optimizer for it then move the subgraph to the forward graph
